description: This file is a CKEditor plugin for font styling, defining a plugin that adds font and font size selection combos to the editor UI, along with configuration settings for font names, sizes, and styles.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.plugins.font
classes.description: CKEditor plugin that adds font and font size selection combos to the editor UI.

methods.name: addCombo
methods.description: Creates and adds a font or font size combo box to the CKEditor UI, populating it with font names or sizes, and handling selection changes.
